recap.text: Bonnie, a juvenile Dirigible Gnome, brings crawlers inside to find her father ripped to shreds by her pet. Bonnie has dilated eyes and sets up a lemonade stand under a spell. Carl pulls Bonnie's pink bed and nightstand from his inventory. Bonnie says Denise killed her father and asks for another potion to stop being scared.

Bonnie sits on the guildhall counter and pries the guts out of a disarmed spider automaton. Randy, a smaller bear cub, tells her that heathens burn in the fires of judgement and she is going to hell. Skarn tells Randy not to be mean while a cartoon on the television keeps the cubs and changeling children in the room.

Bonnie arrives in the flag room at Katia's legs wearing a Dallas Cowboys jersey as a dress. She asks Carl why she should not think about killing outworlders. Bonnie hides behind EMP bombs wearing an oversized 105th Scream Warriors shirt. She puts on a farseer helmet too big for her head and fires three short bursts at Reaver missiles.

beats.headline: She brings them inside
beats.text: Subject is a juvenile Dirigible Gnome of the air quadrant, daughter of a commandant. She is the one who brings the crawlers in through the door, and what they find on the other side of it is her father, already dead, ripped to shreds by her new pet, which has gone out for food. The girl's eyes are dilated and she is setting up a lemonade stand. She is under a spell. Nobody discusses the alternative.
beats.gist: Bonnie, a juvenile Dirigible Gnome, brings the crawlers inside to find her shredded father.

beats.headline: Denise killed my dad
beats.text: Subject Bonnie is waking from her father's potion in Skarn's house, where Juice Box is showing her a cot. It is not her bed, so Crawler Carl pulls her own pink bed and nightstand out of his inventory. She states that Denise killed her father, that he knew it was coming and could do nothing, that he told her to make lemonade and gave her the potion so she would stop being scared, and she asks for another one. Juice Box says no. Skarn tells her his parents died when his town was bombed, and that the camels are grumpy but not mean.

beats.headline: Taking apart a spider
beats.text: Bonnie sits on the guildhall counter with a disarmed spider automaton in pieces around her, humming, prying its guts out. Randy, the smaller bear cub, tells her she is going to hell, and that all heathens burn in the fires of judgement. She looks up at him and says nothing. Skarn tells him not to be mean. The changeling children and the cubs have been bickering the whole time, and the cartoon on the television is why they are all still in the room.
beats.gist: Bonnie pries the guts out of a disarmed spider automaton on the guildhall counter.

beats.headline: Have they stopped
beats.text: Subject arrives in the flag room at Katia's legs, wearing a Dallas Cowboys jersey as a dress, having flown in on Louis's new airship, which she prefers to the old one. Skarn is in the hangar playing with it; Louis has hired gremlins, and they have bought door guns. Carl kneels and tells her she should not have to think about that sort of thing. She asks why she should not think about killing outworlders. Have they stopped thinking about killing her?
beats.gist: Bonnie arrives in the flag room at Katia's legs wearing a Dallas Cowboys jersey as a dress.

beats.headline: Splash three
beats.text: Subject and the changeling Skarn were explicitly banned from the door guns of Party Planner, today especially. Subject was found hiding behind the EMP bombs anyway, chewing gum, in an oversized shirt from the 105th Scream Warriors printed with a little girl berserker holding an axe. Carl ordered the ship turned around. Then the Reaver missiles came up through the clouds. Three got through and locked on. Subject unbuckled the gun, put on a farseer helmet too big for her head, and fired three short bursts. Splash three.
beats.gist: Bonnie hides behind EMP bombs in a 105th Scream Warriors shirt and splashes three Reaver missiles.
